our_interpretation: This asserts that all three capabilities are necessary for AGI. It does not specify a deadline or require a particular architecture.
The ordinary reading of solving these problems is reliable general competence, rather than perfect performance on every possible task.
The remarks about pictures and conversation illustrate lesser capabilities; they are not additional forecast conditions.
AGI must be established independently of the three proposed prerequisites, or the assessment would be circular.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishing that each named capability is necessary for independently defined AGI. Present-day failures or an AGI possessing all three capabilities would not alone establish necessity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A broadly accepted, independently evaluated AGI demonstrably lacks at least one of the three named capabilities.
